card.name: Linking words before place names in travel text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (is, on, from, for, in, the) right before a named place or landmark in travel and geography descriptions, e.g. islands, points, palaces and fjords.

modes.label: Verb or preposition before a landmark
modes.description: A word like is, on, from or in that comes just before a named place in a scenic description.
modes.example: Not far from Taharaa Point<< is>> Point Venus, named for Captain Cook’s

modes.label: Inside place or group names
modes.description: Part of a proper name of a place or people, such as an island or tribe.
modes.example: between William Knox D'Arcy representatives and Bakhti<<ari>> Tribe leaders (Khans).

card.writes: Little clear effect; it suppresses 'Indian' and similar words, which hints it steers away from Indian-themed continuations.
card.plain: It fires on the small connecting word just before a place name in travel writing about islands, mountains and palaces.
